arms.C: A physical baseline plus common features
arms.D: B physical baseline plus common and FSPM features

feature_policy.inactive_crop: Keep exported biological zeros. Encode missing stress as 0 with a separate available fraction and active fraction; the placeholder is not a no-stress measurement.
feature_policy.unknown: Reject missing/nonfinite common or structural FSPM inputs; never fill with synthetic crop defaults or drop all plant features.
feature_policy.preprocessing: Strict ordered feature schema; StandardScaler fitted on 60 TRAIN rows only for each arm. No learned target transform or global feature filtering.
feature_policy.history: No lagged observations or sequence models. Every candidate covers the same 36 VALIDATION months.
feature_policy.inference: Retrospective monthly inference using full-month weather/model states; not advance forecasting.

selection: Minimum unrounded RMSE of clipped corrected Q on VALIDATION; exact ties by candidate id ascending. Same six candidates for C and D; no budget extension.
final_fit: Keep the winning estimator/scaler fitted on TRAIN only, with no refit after selection. Freeze both bundles before delivery 4.

simple_references.climatology: For each calendar month, arithmetic mean of the five TRAIN observed monthly Q values; reuse unchanged in VALIDATION/TEST.
simple_references.affine_A_B: For each physical arm, fit y=a*x+b on TRAIN by least squares with a>=0 and unconstrained b: a=max(0,cov(x,y)/var(x)), b=mean(y)-a*mean(x); if var(x)=0, a=0. Predict max(0,a*x+b). No validation fitting or tuning.

test_policy: No TEST outcome query, export, training, scoring or selection. Delivery 4 consumes the frozen bundles and paired temporal bootstrap from the parent protocol.
limitations: One basin, 60 TRAIN months and 36 previously explored development validation months.
FSPM parameters and states are model-derived, not independent physiological observations.
A/B retain substantial bias; ML improvement does not validate physical processes or conserve water balance.
D versus C combines a changed physical baseline and extra model features; it does not isolate FSPM feature value on the same physical arm.
